units.source_text: 他说着将一枝枝浸在水里的燕子花拿了出来，仔细地端详了一番，尔后又将剪子插入水中，在水里剪掉了花茎。

en.t: As he said this, he took out the irises one by one from where they had been soaking in the water, examined them carefully for a while, then put the scissors back into the water and cut off the flower stems underwater.

units.source_text: 他手里拿着的燕子花的投影，在铺席上大幅度地晃动着。

en.t: The shadow of the irises he held in his hand swayed broadly across the matting.
Then, all at once, he said again:
